criteria_results.reasoning: The memo explicitly distinguishes between Teams 1:1/group chat messages (90-day auto-purge) and Teams channel messages (1-year auto-purge) in multiple places. In Section I, it lists both as separate automated deletion processes: 'the Teams chat 90-day purge' and 'the Teams channel 1-year purge.' In Section V.A, the data source inventory has separate rows for 'Teams 1:1 / group chat' (90-day auto-purge) and 'Teams channel messages' (1-year auto-purge) with different risk assessments. The memo also notes in Section X that 'Teams channel posts from Q1 2024 begin purging: Jan 1, 2025' as a separate deadline from the chat purge deadline of December 16, 2024.
